⏳Relaunch : July 3rd 2026⏳

This game is a passion project where we make/port/showcase some of our favourite things as fully functional avatars in Roblox : )

**Currently a very early/Alpha build**

⭐👍 If you enjoy, also be sure to like and favorite, and share this game and our group with your friends 😊

📚 Please be sure to interact with the Help / INFO NPC  !📚 

❗ **If an outfit doesn't show properly in the inspect/purchase menu please equip it again and check again**  ❗

✅ Also if something you are hoping for isn't available just yet be sure to check again after a week or two, as we will be updating the game frequently, and also have some content premade for future updates. ✅

-----------------------------------------------------

For more realistic UGCs beyond whats shown in this game, ranging from Anime, Videogames, FIlms and more please be sure to join our main group and check out our affiliated groups also.  : )

https://www.roblox.com/groups/34523870/Monopolys-UGC#!/about
